description: This file defines the GDPR email controller class for the admin section of OpenCart, responsible for handling GDPR-related email notifications such as data export, approval, and removal. It includes methods for exporting user data, sending approval and denial emails, and manages email content and configuration.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class for handling GDPR-related email operations in the admin panel, including exporting user data, approval, and denial notifications.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that determines which GDPR email action to perform based on the user request (export, approve, remove, deny).

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports user data related to GDPR request, assembles email content, and sends the GDPR export email.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Sends an approval email for GDPR requests.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Sends a denial or removal email for GDPR requests.
